endpoint.note: user-owned remote endpoint only; empty url (or __USER_OWNED__ placeholder) means UNCONFIGURED: optional continues structured, required blocks typed; never a fixed local listener default; real VPS deploy and port re-preflight are HOLD (operator infra)

circuit.note: identical to the canonical MCP safety envelope: two consecutive timeout/network failures in one planner turn open the circuit per (server, capability, turn); expired cooldown allows one half-open probe

scoping.note: workspace and project travel together always (project scoping rules preserved); absence of remote config never falls back to any local listener

criticality.note: optional plus unavailable yields AIMEMORY_UNAVAILABLE with fallback_continue=true and blocked=false; required plus unavailable yields AIMEMORY_REQUIRED_BLOCKED with blocked=true in every branch
